admission.justification: An unbounded archive chain could consume host operations without terminating; the exact exhaustion and last-live case guards the finite resource boundary.

applicability: Archive-successor traversal during explicit task workspace preparation.
conditions: At most eight successor steps follow the original key.
A ninth observed archived descriptor refuses before another create and names task and count.
exclusions: An unlimited search or a local archive-history store.

evidence: evidence/A02/focused.log; ReopenedWorkspaceTests.test_archive_traversal_has_a_fixed_bound_and_names_the_task_and_count covers exhaustion and a live final allowed successor.

statement: Workspace successor traversal permits at most eight successor steps and nine create/refresh calls, then refuses with the task identity and observed archived count.
